snippet.title: Solitile gameplay (PC Game, 1991)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Solitile, Dos PC game produced by Everett Kaser in 1991 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/solitile/6005/
Trying to finish the first level of this epic reflexion oriented game of first nineties.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
